control.window: Controlled in the background — you keep using your mouse and keyboard.
control.tab: Controlled in the background, inside Godmode's browser.
control.desktop: Uses your real mouse and keyboard — you'll see everything the agent does.

setup.allowDescription: Privacy & Security → Accessibility and Screen & System Audio Recording. Restart Godmode if pictures stay black afterwards.
setup.offBody: Turn it on in <link>Settings → Computer</link> to share windows and screens with agents.
setup.permTitleBoth: Godmode needs Accessibility and Screen Recording
setup.guide_one: A short guide shows where to switch it on.
setup.guide_other: A short guide shows where to switch them on.
setup.noScreen: Without Screen Recording, agents can't see windows.
setup.noAccessibility: Without Accessibility, they can't click or type.
setup.cuaTitle: Install Cua Driver for sharing single windows
setup.cuaMac: Open-source (trycua/cua): clicks buttons and fills fields through accessibility, even when the window is covered. Godmode's built-in helper works without it.
setup.cuaOther: Open-source (trycua/cua): needed on this system to see and control windows and the screen.

page.title: Computer
page.description: What agents can see and control when you share it in a chat. Watch any display, window or browser tab here and take over when needed.
page.nothingDescription: Open an app window or connect a display, then refresh.
page.shareHint: To let an agent work here, open a chat and use Share in the message box — then pick {{target}}.

panel.title: Shared
panel.footer: {{name}} sees only what you share here, and only while it's shared. Stopping takes effect immediately.

share.noBrowser: No Godmode browser is open. Open one on the Browser page — or share a window of your own browser instead.
share.noteWindow: The agent controls only this window, in the background — your mouse and keyboard stay yours.
share.noteTab: The agent controls only this tab of Godmode's browser, in the background.
share.noteScreen: The agent uses your real mouse and keyboard on the shared screen. You can stop it any time.
share.title: Share with {{name}}
share.description: Choose what the agent may see and control in this chat. Stop sharing whenever you like.

live.controlBackground: You're in control — clicks, scrolling and typing go to the shared window, in the background.
live.controlReal: You're in control — clicks and typing move your real mouse and keyboard.
live.viewportControl: Shared screen — keyboard and mouse input is forwarded
live.clickForKeyboard: Click the picture to send keyboard input
